time_policy.T0_rule: atomically persist immediately before first formal bulk operation, including ingestion/indexing; not first Chat

evaluation_lines.A: fixed-QID same evidence/Context route fairness; answer/citation/usage/latency; does not establish retrieval quality
evaluation_lines.B: independent dataset Gold parsing/retrieval/context/answer diagnostics with explicit applicability/denominators
evaluation_lines.Hotpot_supporting_facts: needs sentence-level source mapper; official joint NOT_EVALUATED
evaluation_lines.MML_page_scoring: UNKNOWN convention must not score; current scorer has no applicable implemented MML page metric branch
evaluation_lines.Omni: 24 page parsing PROJECT diagnostics; no official QA; no postmodel QA invention

embedding_policy.batch_size: min(32, actual admission.max_batch_items), further constrained by actual per-item/total token capacity

critical_path: G0 frozen two-stage patch and necessary counterexamples → fresh finite lease/profile and existing authority/DB/stream status → fixed raw/prepared SETUP inputs and plans
G1 real raw+prepared ingestion/READY → query/rerank when required → sealed wire → fair scored three arms/citation → trace readback → safe SSH disconnect/recovery without duplicate sends
G2 coordinate semantic review → atomic T0/5h →748 bulk units with independent existing-READY reuse → full index manifest →40Q×3 plus24 page parsing scores → trace/aggregate/checkpoint/results

minimal_fix_packages.P2: operator normal ingestion/job/source-map/exact batch plans and frozen component entry
minimal_fix_packages.P3: necessary source/page applicability and Omni prediction export + numeric Scores mapping
minimal_fix_packages.P4: finite detached wrapper and real checkpoint recovery proof
